title: 특급 다음 전체 획 검토 후보
basis: Exact dictionary title, consistent source metadata and at least one licensed candidate with matching catalog stroke count. These are intake conditions, not approval.
requiredReview: Observe every source stroke in delay order, including the initial stroke.
Compare direction, stroke boundaries, pen lifts and final glyph form against the selected licensed candidate.
When several corpora match the count, prefer the one whose stroke directions are closest to the dictionary, not the fixed order.
Record character-specific differences; never auto-split or substitute glyphs from count or radicals alone.
Promote only completed records under their actual source provenance.
